notes.title: Game Lens v0.71 — Neuro Upscale
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Release Notes (v0.71)[/b]

[quote][b]Update v0.71 – Neuro Upscale[/b]
Introduces the first built-in [b]Neural Upscaler[/b] with multiple model options. Each model trades speed for quality differently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/78b3d0e3ab56df60f6ac6cc150a5161a91c2782a.gif[/img]

[b]Test rig[/b]: Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3 GHz · RTX 3070 Laptop 8 GB GDDR6 · 64 GB RAM.
[/quote]

[h2]🧠 Neural Upscaler[/h2]
[list]
[*] Multiple neural models available; ranked from [b]fastest 🟢[/b] to [b]slowest / highest quality🔴[/b].
[*] [b]Performance tip[/b]: use a [b]smaller lens window[/b] and a [b]higher Zoom[/b]. Smaller window + higher zoom = noticeably faster upscaling.
[*] Recommended to try first: [b]AnimeVideoV3[/b], [b]UltraSharp[/b], and [b]ClearReality[/b].
[/list]

[h3]📜 Licensing[/h3]
[list]
[*] All models are open-licensed for use [i]except[/i] [b]UltraSharp[/b] and [b]ClearReality[/b].
[*] [b]UltraSharp[/b] and [b]ClearReality[/b] were [i]exclusively provided[/i] by [url=url=https://github.com/Kim2091]Kim2091[/url] to [b]Likhoi[/b] for use in Game Lens.
[/list]

[h3]📊 Sample tests[/h3]
[i]Screenshots comparing different models will be added here.[/i]
[list]
[h3]🟣 NATIVE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/f75d57612ab56322b10895370a55c738db36d519.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/e9266ca0b5d6c5720137fe9ac44930fd586be952.png[/img]

[h3]🟢 ESPCN[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/56d3993acca6ac5a4e9122a613d65bb786d6cf81.png[/img]

[h3]🟡 AnimeVideoV3[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/4422a301bc531025d58ded6f0db64a6749f385f4.png[/img]

[h3]🟡 ClearReality v1 (SOFT)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/0542400e2f0322ee7a6aebdebb38d9cb81c8be18.png[/img]

[h3]🔴 UltraSharp v1[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/7277caf2aaa8e772bbef19b17bd05bc83f1b0e0c.png[/img]

[/list]

[h3]🛠 Bug fixes & improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved main [b]ON/OFF[/b] toggle logic — should “stick” incorrectly far less often.
[*] [b]Click-Through[/b] now persists after hiding and showing the lens window again (previously could block clicks until retoggled).
[*] Minor stability and UI polish.
[/list]

[h3]🔭 Next up (v0.72)[/h3]
Focused work on [b]Windows 10[/b] stability and compatibility.

[h3]💬 Feedback[/h3]
Report bugs and share feedback in [url=url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url].

[b]Patch notes date:[/b] Sep 16, 2025
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.71

notes.title: Game Lens Update v0.70
notes.content:
[b]Game Lens – Release Notes (v0.70) [/b]

[quote][b]Update v0.70[/b]
New features, fixes, and smoother UI animations.
The app is still [b]25% OFF[/b] for [b]two weeks[/b] after release: [b]Sep 2 → Sep 16[/b].
Report issues and share feedback in our [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url].[/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842680/Game_Lens

[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Follow Cursor (new)[/b] 
[b]Toggle[/b] (default: [i]Numpad 1[/i]) and [b]Push/Hold[/b] (default: [i]Numpad 0[/i]) modes
Optional [b]double-click[/b] activation window (shared for both modes)
Restores your previous window/capture position when turned off

[*] [b]Less cursor flicker[/b] – Reduced cursor jitter while the lens is visible.
[/list]


[h2]🛡 Safe Mode (Anti‑cheat) compatibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Auto‑disabled with clear UI[/b] – In Safe Mode, the following features turn OFF, gray out, and their switches animate to the OFF position:
[*] [b]Follow Cursor[/b], [b]Quick Setup[/b], [b]Smooth show/hide[/b], [b]Show Crosshair[/b], [b]Show Zoom Hint[/b], [b]Color[/b], [b]Sensitivity[/b], [b]Click‑through[/b], [b]Window Opacity[/b]
[*] Active gestures/follow mode are stopped immediately for clarity.
[/list]

[h2]🎨 UI/UX [/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Hotkey inputs restyled[/b] – Violet bordered inputs for better visibility:
Applies to main hotkeys, [b]Follow Cursor[/b] hotkeys, and [b]Zoom Presets[/b].
[/list]

[h2]🛠 Bug fixes & improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed opacity/fade conflicts; animations no longer interfere with opacity changes.
[*] Restored 50% transparency while dragging in Quick Setup, even with fade enabled.
[*] Fixed common toggle visual desync (switch stuck ON position with OFF colors).
[*] Improved per‑monitor DPI handling for Follow Cursor to eliminate corner drift.
[/list]


[b]Sale:[/b] 25% OFF from [b]Sep 2[/b] to [b]Sep 16[/b]
[b]Release date:[/b] 07 Sep 2025
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.70

notes.title: Game Lens Release
notes.content:
[b]🎉 Game Lens – Release Notes (v0.69) 🎉[/b]

[quote][b]It’s release time![/b]  
Game Lens officially launches on Steam today!  
To celebrate, the app is [b]25% OFF[/b] for the next [b]two weeks[/b]. Don’t miss it!  
Please report any issues in our [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord[/url].[/quote]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842680/Game_Lens/
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/a43e6945dfc5bc67f537851972e7d6bdf8096666.gif[/img]
[h2]✨ Highlights[/h2]
[list]

[b]Double-click hotkey[/b] – New [b]Push/Toggle via double-tap[/b]! Show the lens by pressing a hotkey twice quickly (default: [b]300 ms[/b], customizable).
[b]Steam Cloud sync[/b] – Config files now automatically synchronize between your PCs via [b]Steam Cloud[/b].
[b]Localized store screenshots[/b] – The Steam store page now displays language-specific screenshots for each supported locale.

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/ef377817fcea143f4f2f00fbdb8835661d4c9be2.png[/img]
[h2]➤ Security/Compliance Notes[/h2]
[list]
No drivers, no admin rights, no low-level hooks.  
All user data remains in [tt]%APPDATA%\Game Lens[/tt].  

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/e6e23e6f4d288a9ce5115e499c0af1b5597980c5.png[/img]
[i]Thanks for supporting the journey to 1.0 release!  
Click the [b]Discord[/b] button in-app and share your feedback – it helps us improve Game Lens even faster.[/i]

[b]Release date:[/b] 2025-09-02
[b]Build number:[/b] 0.69

notes.title: Game Lens is now live on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/472be856bab45caed20283096234760dc4431307.png[/img]
[h1]🟣 Game Lens is now live on Steam — Playtest open![/h1]

Finally!  
Game Lens is now live on Steam and [b]anyone can join the open playtest[/b].

🎯 [b]What is it?[/b]  
Game Lens is a customizable zoom lens overlay that lets you [i]magnify any part of your screen in real time[/i], right on top of your game or app.  
Ideal for gamers, streamers, designers, or anyone needing pixel-perfect focus.

💬 [b]Feedback matters[/b]  
I'm a solo developer, so your bug reports, feature requests, and feedback [i]really[/i] help!  
Feel free to message me or join the community:  
→ [url=https://discord.gg/bFCtMKUADc]Discord Server[/url]  
→ [url=https://x.com/GameLensApp]Twitter / X[/url]  
→ Or post in the Steam Discussions tab

🔔 [b]Wishlist & support[/b]  
If Game Lens feels useful — [b]please add it to your wishlist[/b]. It helps a lot with visibility and launch.

→ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3842680/Game_Lens/]Visit Steam Page[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674736/28b08004e59a34955baa4413596fd755ed6d91ac.png[/img]

📺 [b]YouTube Channel[/b]  
Shorts, showcases, memes, tutorials – coming soon:  
→ [url=https://www.youtube.com/@gamelenssoft]Game Lens on YouTube[/url]

Thanks to everyone who helped me reach this milestone.  
Now go test it — break it — and tell me what you'd love to see next!

— Likhoi 🛠
